title: How Machyon finds a server's limit
description: 1,500 images from a server that answers 429 (with Retry-After: 1) whenever more than 24 requests are in flight, each answer taking about 100 ms. Four runs on the identical scenario: fixed at 8, fixed at 48, adaptive starting at 4, and fixed at exactly 24, the limit Machyon isn't told.
